text.zh: 用分子表面、局部官能团与电子结构描述符，连接分子结构、性质预测和化学解释。
text.en: Connecting molecular structure, property prediction and chemical interpretation through molecular surfaces, local functional groups and electronic descriptors.

alt.en: Six SHAP analyses relating two-photon absorption to conjugation, fragment descriptors, wavelength and solvent.

title.zh: 自动化电化学与智能电镀

text.zh: 推进自动化配液、电化学测试、数据分析与实验决策，探索连接分子设计、界面响应和镀层性能的研究流程。
text.en: Developing workflows for automated dosing, electrochemical measurements, data analysis and experimental decisions, linking molecular design with interface responses and deposit performance.

alt.en: Overview connecting literature extraction, datasets, hypotheses, experiment design and computational analysis in catalyst discovery.
alt.zh: 催化剂研究中连接文献信息提取、数据集、假设、实验设计与计算分析的总体工作流。

caption.en: Connecting information, experiments and computation: the overview from our 2024 review.
caption.zh: 连接信息、实验与计算：2024 年综述中的总体工作流示意。

figure.attribution: Y. Su et al. · Chemical Science (2024) · Fig. 1 · © RSC

title.zh: 光功能材料与计算化学

text.zh: 结合量子化学和机器学习研究双光子吸收、框架材料与催化问题，并开发可复用的科研软件与数据工具。
text.en: Combining quantum chemistry and machine learning for two-photon absorption, framework materials and catalysis, supported by reusable research software and data tools.

alt.en: Two-photon absorption workflow from experimental molecules through fragment and conjugation features to model validation and chemical hypotheses.
alt.zh: 双光子吸收研究从实验分子、片段与共轭特征到模型验证和化学假设的流程图。

caption.en: Two-photon absorption: molecular features, model validation and chemically testable hypotheses.
caption.zh: 双光子吸收：分子特征、模型验证与可检验的化学假设。
